scripts.test:e2e: vp run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.dev: varlock run --inject vars -- vp exec portless ao3tracker --app-port 5173 vp dev
scripts.deploy:dev: vp build --mode dev && wrangler deploy --config dist/ssr/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:prod: vp build --mode prod && wrangler deploy --config dist/ssr/wrangler.json
scripts.db:generate: varlock run --inject vars -- vp exec drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:migrate: varlock run --inject vars -- vp node scripts/migrate.mjs
scripts.db:push: varlock run --inject vars -- vp exec drizzle-kit push
scripts.better-auth-gen-schema: varlock run --inject vars -- vp dlx @better-auth/cli@latest generate --config ./better-auth.config.ts --output ./src/db/schema/.temp.auth.ts
scripts.precommit: vp run biome:ci && vp run types:cf && vp run types:tsc
